prompts.text: # follow-amber-fuzzy: console_show highlight finds things fuzzily and always flashes Brett, Nov 5 2026 (voice): "It's supposed to be flashing." ... "I don't need exact name. Use regular expressions. Do your best." Today console_show(target screen:builds, highlight "skins") and "skins-r3" opened Builds and reported 'highlighted' but Brett saw no flash. ## Fix (follow-amber plugin + the console side that resolves `highlight`) - `highlight` accepts plain words, a /regex/, or a CSS selector.
